learning.intro: When a stage counts as learned.

course.manualEntry: Your university has no online catalog in Shalav yet. Enter the course details from the syllabus.
course.notFound: We couldn't find this course in the catalog. You can enter the details manually.
course.afterAdd: After you add the course you can add its files (or import them from Moodle), then build the study plan.

plan.building: Building the study plan… you can keep using Shalav meanwhile.
plan.failed: The study plan could not be built.

step.cover: Making sure every topic is covered

plan.firstBody: Add lecture notes and example exercises below, or import them from Moodle. When you are ready, press Build plan; Shalav builds it from the syllabus and your files so no topic is left out.
plan.buildHint: Ready? The plan is built from the syllabus and all the files above.
plan.upToDate: Every file has been scanned and the plan is up to date. Add new files to update it.
plan.joined: In line: the chat that is building now continues with this course.
plan.studyMeanwhile: The plan is being built in the chat where you pressed the button. You can study in a new chat meanwhile.
plan.updateHint: Added files? Update the plan: Shalav scans the new files and makes sure every topic in them and in the example exercises has a stage.

del.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
del.academic: This topic is part of your university course, so skipping it may leave a gap you will need in the exam.
del.back: If it appears in your course files, Update plan may bring it back.

advance.title: Move to the next stage?
advance.body: You haven't finished learning and practicing this stage yet. Still missing:
advance.note: You can continue anyway. The stage will be marked "skipped ahead" and will come back in practice.

file.heicWindows: HEIC files aren't supported on Windows. Save the photo as JPG and try again.
file.failed: The file could not be added.
file.tooManyPages: The file has too many pages.

net.offline: No internet connection. We'll continue when you're back online.

university.label: University
university.locked: Fixed. To change it, reset Shalav completely by deleting the data folder.
university.title: Choose your university
university.hint: This sets the course number format. It cannot be changed later.

moodle.title: Import from Moodle
moodle.hint: The first time, Shalav downloads its own browser (about 190 MB). A login window opens so you can log in to your university Moodle (including two-step verification), then it closes and the import runs in the background. Shalav never sees your password.
moodle.installing: Downloading the browser for Moodle (one time)…
moodle.login: Log in in the browser window that opened…

err.install: Could not download the browser for Moodle. Check your internet connection and try again.
err.closed: The login window was closed before the login finished. Try again.
err.timeout: The login timed out. Try again and log in in the window that opens.
err.http: Moodle did not answer properly. Try again in a few minutes.
err.noCourse: No Moodle course with the number {{number}} was found. Check that you are enrolled.
err.login: The Moodle login did not work. Try again.
err.url: The Moodle address is not valid. It must start with https://

files.teacherHint: Your graded homework and exams, rubrics, and notes of what your teacher said. Only the teacher's comments are used, never your own answers, and they weigh most.
files.dropHint: Drop files here or use the button.
files.rescanned: {{name}} will be scanned again on the next plan update.
files.removeAsk: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}} from {{folder}}?

practice.locked: Complete your first stage to unlock practice
practice.chooseTitle: What do you want to practice?
practice.noItems: We couldn't find a question for this scope yet. Try another scope.
practice.question: Question

modes.title: How do you want to practice?
modes.homeworkText: Upload your homework and solve it question by question with the tutor, or let the AI solve it for you.
modes.singleText: Upload one question and solve it together with the tutor.
modes.normalText: Practice what you've learned in Shalav, at your level.
modes.testText: Only questions from past exams in your course files, each one once. Get one wrong and you get similar ones until it is perfect.
modes.customText: New exercises on everything you learned up to the unit you choose, at your level, solved step by step with the tutor.

custom.pick: Practice what you learned up to which unit?

test.title: Test practice
test.found: {{n}} past exam questions found, {{left}} not served yet.
test.none: No past exams found in the course files. Add exams (for example "Moed A 2023", "midterm", "quiz") to the folders and scan them.
test.drop: Photos or a PDF of the quiz material the course published

note.stern: Not good enough. On the exam that costs you points. You don't move on until you get this concept right: here is a similar question.
note.weak: Two more tries and still not there. Noted: "{{concept}}" needs more practice. Moving on to another subject for now.
note.learned: Four perfect in a row: "{{concept}}" is under control now.

test.generateFailed: Could not write a new question like this one. Try again.

exercise.drop: Solve it in your notebook (paper or tablet), then upload a photo or PDF of the whole solution

job.stopped: Stopped — Claude stopped working on it. Try again.

mcp.waiting: Waiting for Claude to work on it…

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataHint: Change it in the extension settings in Claude Desktop.
settings.conflicts: Sync conflict copies found. Shalav ignores them; delete them after checking nothing is missing:

mcp.replaced: This card was replaced by a newer one below.
mcp.pressEnter: Ready in the message box. Press Enter so Claude continues.

translate.note_one: 1 item of the plan isn't in English yet.
translate.note_other: {{count}} items of the plan aren't in English yet.

custom.title: Create a custom course
custom.intro: Learn anything you like: tell us what and where you start from, and the study plan is built around you.
custom.name: Course name
custom.descriptionPh: What do you want to learn? Which topics, why, and anything you already know or want to skip.
custom.descriptionHint: Elaborate as much as you can: the more detail, the better the study plan fits you.
custom.goalPh: What do you want to be able to do when you finish?

web.title: Materials from the internet
web.body: Claude searches the web for study texts and practice exercises that match your level ({{level}}/5) and adds them to your course files. Then press {{plan}} to fit the plan to them.
web.countNew: Only files not already in your course are added.
web.countPlan: Only files not already in your course are added, spread over the plan's units so each one gets a fair share.

loop.drop: Stuck? Upload what you've written so far and press Get a clue. Done? Upload the whole solution (photo or PDF) and submit it.

intro.homework: Upload the homework pages. Shalav reads the questions, then you choose how to solve them.
intro.single: Upload the question. You'll solve it with the tutor: ask for a clue when you're stuck, and submit your full solution when you're done.

drop.homework: Photos or a PDF of the homework (up to 12 pages)
drop.single: A photo or PDF of the question

homework.failed: We couldn't read it. Try clearer photos.
homework.how: How do you want to solve it?
homework.tutorText: One question at a time, with clues when you're stuck. Each perfect solution goes into your solution file, in your own handwriting.
homework.allDone: All the questions are solved! Download your solutions.
homework.aiText: Full, detailed solutions of every question, written like the course's example solutions, in one PDF.
homework.paused: Solving stopped. Continue from where it stopped; solved questions are kept.
homework.solveFailed: Something went wrong while solving. Try again; solved questions are kept.
